name: PubChem PUG REST API (NIH)
extraction_instructions: Look for 'Information' array in the response. Extract the 'Description' and 'Title' under 'Pharmacology and Biochemistry' or 'Biological Description'. Focus on biological role, physiological action, and documented toxicity/safety baseline.

name: MedlinePlus Connect Service (NIH / NLM)
extraction_instructions: Parse the 'feed' -> 'entry' array. Locate the 'summary' HTML/text block. Extract statements regarding recommended usage, evidence-based health claims, interactions, and consumer safety notes.

name: USDA FoodData Central API
extraction_instructions: Inspect 'foods' -> 'foodNutrients' list. Extract nutritional density per 100g, baseline daily intake reference values, primary natural dietary sources, and official serving recommendations.

name: DailyMed Label Database (NIH / NLM)
extraction_instructions: Parse the SPL JSON structure for 'data' entries. Focus on sections labeled 'INDICATIONS & USAGE', 'DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION', and 'WARNINGS/PRECAUTIONS'. Extract official regulatory usage limits and safety disclaimers.

name: Europe PMC Open Access (EMBL-EBI)
extraction_instructions: Search 'resultList' -> 'result'. Extract the 'abstractText' and 'title'. Focus on extracting consensus findings from systematic reviews, regulatory assessments, and clinical efficacy conclusions.

name: Licensed Natural Health Products Database (Health Canada)
extraction_instructions: Parse monograph details for 'purpose_name', 'approved_subclause', and 'dose'. Extract authorized health claims, maximum tolerable daily intake levels, and mandatory risk statements.
